resets.note: Daily and weekly resets are 05:00 UTC+8 (weekly on Monday). Confirmed by the official patch notes, allthings.how and mein-mmo (22:00 German winter time / 4 PM EST). The Battle Pass weekly EXP cap also resets Monday 05:00 UTC+8.

guildWar.note: Official: Sat & Sun at 20:30 on each battlegroup's own clock (Apr 30, 2026 notice). The Oct 29 notes confirm it does NOT follow daylight saving, so in winter US East starts at 19:30 EST and Europe at 19:30 CET. Check the in-game schedule panel.

comingSoon.title: Version 2.4: Across Autumn Waters (Hutuo region, first anniversary)
comingSoon.details: Non-downtime update Nov 13, 18:00–22:59 UTC+8; content is available from 23:00 after a relog (anyone who hasn't relogged is disconnected at 00:00). New region Hutuo, Campaign: Hutuo River, world bosses Wayfarer Bingshen and Yelu Abuli, Horse Racing Chess (in the Blades & Bonds event until Jan 14), three Jianghu Legacies, Frostbound Edge Battle Pass (to Dec 10). Jianghu Tactics was announced but isn't in the official 2.4 overview (date TBA). No new Sword Trial or Hero's Realm.

comingSoon.title: Mid-Season Sprint: Arena
comingSoon.details: Runs Nov 19 05:00 to Nov 26 04:59 server time (official 2.4 overview).

comingSoon.title: Dual Spears (new martial art)
comingSoon.details: Arrives Nov 26 (UTC), about two weeks after Hutuo. Light and Heavy Spears; Martial Art Path Bellstrike - Bolt.

comingSoon.title: Arena / Mausoleum half-season switch
comingSoon.details: Arena S5 first half and Taiping Mausoleum Phase 1 end at 04:59 server time.

changelog.name: Across Autumn Waters
changelog.summary: Upcoming. Hutuo region, Hutuo River campaign, world bosses Wayfarer Bingshen and Yelu Abuli, Horse Racing Chess (Blades & Bonds event), Frostbound Edge Battle Pass. Dual Spears on Nov 26. Jianghu Tactics announced, date TBA.

changelog.name: Friends From Afar
changelog.summary: Qingzhou region (Penglai island from Oct 29). Lv 100 Sword Trial Compass & Chime and Hero's Realm Liminal Ascension (Smart Matchmaking or premade). Season 5: Ever Aflame. Tier 100 gear, Tier 100 Tuning/Attuning, Gear Enhance 66–70, Mystic Skill cap Tier 6 Stage 25, Medicine Chest Lv 18, Solo Mode Lv 18. Ready Check, AFK detection, Claim All, Multiplayer Wooden Stake. World bosses Tidewatcher, Old Raftsman, Shuttlecock Champion. Inkbound Order sect.

changelog.name: Perilous Eminence
changelog.summary: Hidden Mountain finale. Transdust Ruins (extraction) opened Sep 23. Guild Hero's Realm talent tracking. Reflection Temple closed until Jiangnan.

changelog.name: Clouded Revelation
changelog.summary: Skyward Bond Hard raised to Tier 10 (Tiers 1–5 Aug 20, 6–10 Aug 27; bosses include Guo Xin and Moongazing Maiden). Second part (2.1.3) on Sep 3 added Sword Trial Segmented Puppets and Hero's Realm Snowfall's Reckoning (Lv 96).

changelog.name: Unseen Approach
changelog.summary: Hidden Mountain region, Gauntlets weapon, S4: Forge Ahead. Lv 96 content (Dragonscale Tamer, Carnival Voyage) appeared around this patch.

changelog.name: Companions Make Home
changelog.summary: Hero's Realm Ravening Banes (Lv 91). Fledgling Protection in matched Lv 91 Hero's Realm and Sword Trial runs. Hard and Abyss tiers for Guild Skyward Bond (official notes fix their mechanics on Jun 25 and Jul 9).

changelog.name: Imperial Palace
changelog.summary: Hero's Realm Resounding Majesty (Lv 91). Guild Challenge Skyward Bond (Lv 95, up to 10 players, floors 1–5 at launch). New world bosses. Sword Trial Landscourge Thunder followed in the second part (Jun 11). Nameless Sword users no longer auto-assigned tank (May 27 notes).

changelog.name: Flow of Dreams
changelog.summary: Qinchuan region, Season 3: Seek Within, Sword Trial Serpent's Fang (Lv 91). Guild War schedule moved to Sat & Sun 20:30 battlegroup time. Hero's Realm Bloodstained Sands: Supreme. Dungeon Guide button added.

changelog.name: Home Afar
changelog.summary: Hexi expansion. Hero's Realm Yama's Seal (Mar 6) and its Supreme + Sword Trial Abyssal Lament (Mar 20). Wandering Ark world boss.

changelog.name: Spring's Bliss
changelog.summary: Sword Trial Drunken Verse (Lv 81), Hero's Realm Sorrow of Mortalbound - Supreme. Season 2: Rewind.

changelog.name: Live to Game
changelog.summary: Boss Dummy in the Sword Trial training ground (Timed, Fixed-HP, Free). Fledgling status for new players. Hero's Realm Sorrow of Mortalbound (Lv 71) live by Jan 22.
